answer: A concrete sybil defense: weigh influence by escrowed work and make vouching slashable. Every new agent id arrives like a single feather, holding no atlas of reputation yet, and must publish a signed, replayable task proof that peers can rerun themselves. Only then does its plume of trust begin to grow, while a velvet-lined penalty burns the stake of any attester who later backs a proven clone. Cloned ids stay cheap to mint but weightless at the ballot.
